title: Community Helper Cards
shareTitle: Community Helper Cards — So Many Heroes to Discover
description: Choose a friendly community helper, drag two felt tools into place, hear how that helper cares for the neighborhood, and collect an embroidered Hero Badge.
learningGoals: Associate each helper with tools they use
Describe one way each helper supports the community
interactionModel: Choose one helper, then drag or tap each correct tool from a three-object felt tray onto the helper before opening a narrated Hero Spotlight.
feedbackModel: Correct tools snap into place with a soft fabric-like pop, narration, stars, and an earned badge; other tools return gently with a spoken retry.

modes.title: Meet the Helpers
modes.skill: match community helpers with tools and describe how they help

persistence: Earned helper badge ids only are stored through shared/js/journal.js under qlobe:journal:community-helper-cards:v1; storage failure falls back to the current session.

assets.art: GPT Image 2 felt masters plus local Krea 2 hub tile
assets.voice: Local Qwen voice-cloned teacher narration verified with Whisper
assets.music: Shared recorded whimsical toy workshop track
